editorialQuote.text: With Mediversity Global's support, I not only improved my medical English but also gained invaluable clinical observership experience at a top UK hospital. This experience fundamentally changed my understanding of international medical collaboration.
editorialQuote.author: Dr. Zhang Wei
editorialQuote.role: Associate Chief Physician · Shanghai Ruijin Hospital

testimonials.role1: Jiangxi Provincial Maternal and Child Health Hospital · Attending Physician
testimonials.content1: Mediversity Global's medical English programme helped me confidently present at international academic conferences. My colleagues have all noticed the improvement.
testimonials.role2: Peking Union Medical College Hospital · Resident
testimonials.content2: The OET preparation course was very systematic, and the tutors had an excellent grasp of exam focus areas. I passed OET on my first attempt and secured my UK work visa.
testimonials.role3: Shanghai Ruijin Hospital · Associate Chief Physician
testimonials.content3: The clinical observership programme gave me first-hand experience of the UK NHS working model, which greatly inspired my department management back home.
testimonials.role4: The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University · Attending Physician
testimonials.content4: The academic writing course helped me master core SCI paper writing techniques. I've successfully published two papers this year.
testimonials.role5: The First Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University · Chief Physician
testimonials.content5: The visiting scholar programme opened doors to international collaboration. I now maintain close academic exchanges with UK colleagues.
